name: Rectangle
title: Rectangle: free Magnet alternative
caption:
Magnet costs $4.99 to snap your Mac windows into place. Rectangle does it for free 🪟

✅ Drag a window to a screen edge and it snaps to a half
✅ Corners give you quarters, the bottom edge gives you thirds
✅ Keyboard shortcuts for every layout, fully customizable
✅ Send windows to your next display with one shortcut

💻 Mac
ℹ️ Rectangle is free and open source. A separate app, Rectangle Pro, adds extras like custom snap targets and saved layouts for a one-time $9.99

Comment "SNAP" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

dm_pitch: Rectangle, the free open-source Magnet alternative 🪟

beats.say: Stop dragging your Mac windows around by hand.
Magnet charges five bucks for this. Rectangle does it for free.
Drag a window to an edge, and it snaps to a half, a quarter, or a third.
Or skip the mouse. Every layout has its own keyboard shortcut.
Send a window to your other screen, center it, or maximize it, all with one key.
It's Magnet, minus the price tag.
Comment Snap, and I'll send you the link.
